title: Verify: Runner lock, worktree and timeout unit tests
summary: Unit tests with fakes for lock, worktree and timeout
description: Write runner_test.go with fake Agent, Worktrees and Publisher plus a temp dir for lock and store, proving Act A1 against R1 criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Locked, cleanup and timeout cases each have a passing test
Tests use only fakes and t.TempDir
technical_constraints: fake Agent counts calls and records workDir; fake Worktrees records Create and Remove

steps.symbol: new: fakeAgent, fakeTrees, fakePublisher, newRunner helper
steps.action: Create package runner test file. fakeAgent has fields cost float64, errs []error, block bool, calls int; Run increments calls, if block waits on <-ctx.Done() and returns ctx.Err(), else pops errs. fakeTrees records created, removed []string. fakePublisher records calls. newRunner(t, cfg, agent) builds Config with LockPath and WorkRoot under t.TempDir(), store.New(t.TempDir()), fixed now.
Pre-create the file cfg.LockPath with os.WriteFile; call Run(ctx,"EXEC-1","ROUND-0000001"); assert errors.Is(err, lock.ErrLocked), agent.calls==0 and len(trees.created)==0.

AutoPublish irrelevant; agent succeeds; call Run; assert lock file path does not exist (os.Stat gives fs.ErrNotExist), trees.created equals trees.removed equal to filepath.Join(WorkRoot,"EXEC-1") and agent.workDir equals the same.
agent.block=true, Timeout 20ms; call Run; assert errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) and st.Get("EXEC-1").Status == store.StatusFailed.
